body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> AHA(www.ahainc.co.kr), e-classroom device manufacturer in Korea, presented its multimedia digital podium system 'MAESTRO' at the 2009 International CES.

PC, sound system, lecture record system, notebook pc tray, lecture room control system are all integrated in the MAESTRO. In particular, digital pen on monitor controls PC, the writing in text on monitor is projected to a large screen, and teacher's voice can be saved.

Adopting a 19- and 20-inch wide LCD monitor in 16:9 ratio, the MAESTRO enables teachers to control whole classroom with just one touch. It also offers high-quality audio system by howling protection and noise removal circuit. The MAESTRO can cover up to 400-seat auditorium.
